A hiring center of this kind is a site where a restaurant recruits, interviews, and trains prospective employees; it is standard practice for busy Chick-fil-A locations to set aside space, sometimes a separate suite or trailer near the restaurant, for recruiting events distinct from the dining and kitchen areas customers see.

Nothing in the public record ties this address to data-center, colocation, telecommunications, or computing infrastructure of any kind. This entry does not describe an operating data center, and no technical specifications, power, cooling, square footage, or otherwise, are published here for that simple reason: there are none to publish. The most likely explanation is that this location was picked up in error from a mapping source that combines many kinds of points of interest, and a restaurant hiring center was mistakenly carried into a data-center listing. It remains recorded here for transparency rather than silently dropped, but a reader looking for data-center infrastructure at this address will not find any.
